result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one layout defect stands out: in the "Fastest near you" carousel the second card (Smash Bros Burgers) sits about 28px lower than its neighbours, so the row's images and text do not line up. Nothing else looks clearly broken.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card is pushed down relative to the others. Its image starts at about y=658 while the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria Piccola images start at about y=631. Its title and delivery fee text also sit lower than the neighbouring cards' text, so the row looks uneven.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the top of the row (e.g. align-items: flex-start with no stray top margin or padding on individual cards), and check the second card for an extra margin, transform or wrapper offset.
